description_zh: 本接口用于开始旁路推流任务
kebab_example: aliyun rtc start-streaming-out --app-id eo850000 --channel-id testid --template-id 567 --url rtmp://example.com/live/stream --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartStreamingOut

parameters.help_en: Application ID, created and queried via the console. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: An existing channel ID. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 已存在的频道ID，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: channel_id

parameters.help_en: Template ID.
parameters.help_zh: 模版ID
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: Live ingest URL. Only a single URL is supported. This URL cannot be used by multiple jobs simultaneously
parameters.help_zh: 直播推流地址，仅支持传单个地址。该地址不可多个任务同时使用
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: The task ID of this bypass stream ingest job. Only a single ID is supported. It can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens (-), with a maximum length of 55 bytes. If not specified, the System will automatically generate one.
parameters.help_zh: 本次旁路推流的任务ID，仅支持传单个ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大55字节，不填，则由系统自动生成
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
Crop mode. Valid values:  
1: Crop while maintaining the aspect ratio.  
2: Maintain aspect ratio with padding (Default Value).  
3: Stretch to fill the entire area.
parameters.help_zh:
裁剪方式。取值：
1：保持比例裁剪。
2：保持比例留边（默认值）。
3：拉伸铺满
parameters.name: crop_mode

parameters.help_en:
Reserve pane for users who do not publish camera streams.  
The default value is true, which means a pane is reserved for users who do not publish camera streams.  
If set to false, no pane is reserved for such users.
parameters.help_zh:
未推摄像头流用户窗格占位。
默认为true，表示用户未推摄像头流时保留一个窗格。
为false时，表示用户未推摄像头流时不保留窗格
parameters.name: reserve_pane_for_no_camera_user

parameters.help_en:
Whether to display the default pane background when muted.
true: Display (default value)
false: Do not display (the configured local pane background is still displayed)
parameters.help_zh:
mute时是否显示窗格默认底图。
true: 显示（默认值）
false: 不显示（设置的局部窗格底图依然显示）
parameters.name: show_default_background_on_mute

parameters.help_en:
Subscribe to a high resolution stream.  
false: Subscribe to streams with different resolutions based on the pane area. (Default Value)  
true: By default, fill with the highest resolution stream pushed by the client
parameters.help_zh:
订阅高分辨率流。
false：根据窗格面积订阅不同分辨率的流。（默认值）
true：默认用客户端推的最高分辨率的流进行填充
parameters.name: sub_high_resolution_stream

parameters.help_en:
Whether to allow starting a job when the channel does not exist.
true: Yes
false: No (default value)
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许频道不存在时开启任务。

true: 是
false: 否（默认值）
parameters.name: start_without_channel

parameters.help_en: This value is valid only when the StartWithoutChannel parameter is true. It specifies the maximum time, in seconds, that a job waits if the channel is not open. The allowed range is [30, 120]
parameters.help_zh: 当StartWithoutChannel参数为true的时候，设置该值才有意义，表示房间未开启时，任务等待时长，单位为秒，区间限制为[30,120]
parameters.name: start_without_channel_wait_time

parameters.help_en: Toggle for annotation
parameters.help_zh: 标注开关
parameters.name: annotation

fields.help_en:
Reserve pane for offline users.  
The default value is true, which means that if a specific user or wildcard user assigned to a grid pane is offline, the pane remains reserved.  
If set to false, when a specific user or wildcard user assigned to a grid pane is offline, the pane displays video streams according to the Auto Fill order
fields.help_zh:
未入会用户窗格占位。
默认为true，表示宫格指定的具体用户或通配符用户离线时，窗格强制占位。
为false时，表示宫格指定的具体用户或通配符用户离线时，将按自动填充顺序显示视频流
fields.name: reserve_pane_for_offline_user

fields.help_en:
The media source for the cell. You can specify a userId to indicate a specific user type. Wildcard character configuration is supported, including the following types:

$ActiveSpeaker: The current active speaker in the channel
$ScreenShare: The screen-sharing user. If multiple users are sharing their screens in the channel, they will be filled sequentially in the order they started sharing
fields.help_zh:
单元格媒体源。可指定userId，如需指定特定用户类型。可使用通配符配置，支持以下类型。

$ActiveSpeaker：当前频道发言人
$ScreenShare： 屏幕共享用户，当频道中有多个屏幕共享时，将按照先后顺序依次填充
fields.name: source

fields.help_en:

screen: Screen sharing stream.

parameters.help_en:
The layout generation uses a user-specified list, which includes both blacklist and whitelist.

Whitelist: specifies which users' video streams to subscribe to in the channel.  
After configuration, Auto Fill populates slots sequentially based on this list.  
When switching between multiple layouts in a template, only users in the whitelist are considered.

Blacklist: specifies which users' video streams not to subscribe to in the channel.  
When switching between multiple layouts in a template, only users not in the blacklist are considered
parameters.help_zh:
布局生成用户指定列表，包括黑/白名单两种。

白名单，指定订阅房间里哪些用户视频流。
设置后自动填充根据该列表进行顺序填充
模版多布局切换时只计算白名单中的人

黑名单，指定不订阅房间里哪些用户视频流。
模版多布局切换时只计算非黑名单中的人
parameters.name: layout_specified_users
